ad_info.structure_source: library format F40 (Carta de texto) — estructuras/mv-08.json
ad_info.reference_style: Text-letter ad: bold 2-line headline top left, a short letter of a few paragraphs with bold phrases on a solid dark background, the bottle cut-out tilted and cropped by the right edge, an italic signature
ad_info.angle_used: Promesa emocional — a letter for the woman who wants more curves without an operating room (pain: fear of surgery or injections)

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: solid dark plum #2B1226 as the full background.
global_identity.visual_style: Text letter on a solid dark plum background, the real bottle as a sharp cut-out, and a real phone-photo inset of the pain moment.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Intimate and reassuring, like a message from someone who understands; calm, never clinical.
global_identity.graphic_language: Plenty of solid background, clean left-aligned paragraphs with bold pink phrases, a white-framed photo inset, a cut-out bottle cropped by the edge, a fuchsia bottom band with a bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; letter body in Poppins Regular with Poppins Bold phrases; signature in an elegant italic script.

creative_objective: Speak to the woman who wants curves but fears an operating room or injections, in a close letter: we understand the jean that doesn't fill out at the back, here is a natural 3-month plan with 2 capsules a day, no needles, and you pay when you receive it. The mirror inset makes the pain visible; the bottle and the band close the sale.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the headline 'UNA CARTA PARA TI', 2) the first paragraph with the pain, 3) the mirror inset and the tilted bottle, 4) the rest of the letter, 5) the signature, 6) the fuchsia band.
art_direction.composition_style: Text column on the left (5–56% width); right column with the photo inset on top and the tilted bottle cut by the right edge below, overlapping the inset's lower corner; band across the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Left-aligned paragraphs separated by one blank line, generous line height; consistent 5% left margin; band separated from the signature.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat solid background; the bottle with soft studio light from the left and a faint fuchsia rim on the right edge; the inset photo lit by warm lamp light.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top 18%: 2-line heavy headline top left. Middle 68%: LEFT, a letter of 4 short paragraphs in white with bold phrases; RIGHT, a real phone-photo inset of the pain moment on top and the bottle cut-out tilted about 12 degrees and cropped by the right edge below. Then the italic signature at the bottom left. Bottom 10% (added by batch rule): fuchsia band with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and the registration badge.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: empathy, mechanism and offer told as a letter
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: 4 short paragraphs, white with bold bubblegum pink phrases

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: shows the pain moment (at least 25% of the canvas)
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: real phone photo at a bedroom wardrobe mirror
real closed bottle tilted about 12 degrees, its right side cropped by the edge

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: mandatory 'Pagas al recibir' and registration badge
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: hot fuchsia band with white text and a plum badge with a white border

forbidden_additions: Prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials with names, 'envío gratis'
'La oferta se acaba' or any false urgency
Icons, benefit lists or CTA buttons inside the letter
Needles, syringes, surgical or medical imagery
Loose capsules or an open bottle

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 text-letter ad on a solid flat dark plum #2B1226 background with no texture and no gradient. TOP ZONE (3–18% height, 5–55% width): 2-line headline left-aligned, Montserrat Black uppercase, very heavy, each line about 7% of the canvas height: line 1 white #FFFFFF, line 2 bubblegum pink #FF8CC0. MIDDLE ZONE (20–88% height). LEFT (5–56% width): a letter of 4 short paragraphs, left-aligned, white Poppins Regular about 2.8% of the canvas height per line, comfortable line spacing, one blank line between paragraphs; the marked phrases in Poppins Bold bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (in paragraph 1 'no querer pasar por un quirófano', in paragraph 2 '2 cápsulas al día', in paragraph 3 'plan natural de 3 meses', in paragraph 4 'tratamiento completo x3' and 'pagas al recibir'). Under the letter (82–88% height), the signature in an elegant white italic script. RIGHT (56–98% width, 3–62% height): a real smartphone photo inset with a thin 6 px white frame, rotated 3 degrees, soft drop shadow, about 25% of the canvas: a Colombian woman around 33, warm brown skin with visible pores and natural texture, dark shoulder-length curly hair, burgundy knit sweater and black skinny jeans, standing back three-quarters to a wardrobe mirror in her bedroom at night, warm bedside lamp light, phone held up for a selfie, the other hand on her back pocket, the seat of the jeans flat and the denim wrinkling empty under the pocket, she looks over her shoulder at her reflection with a worried, thoughtful face, lips pressed. RIGHT EDGE (60–100% width, 48–90% height): the real product bottle as a clean cut-out, front view, tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, about 42% of the canvas height, its right side cropped by the right edge of the canvas (about 20% of the bottle out of frame), its upper left overlapping the lower left corner of the photo inset, label facing the camera and the visible part readable, soft studio light from the left, a faint hot-fuchsia rim on its right edge, a soft shadow on the background. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Always closed with its cap on; no loose capsules; the label reads the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM ZONE (90–100% height): a full-width hot fuchsia #E6177F band: left, white Montserrat Black uppercase 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' with a small white hand-and-coin line icon; right, a rounded badge with a dark plum #2B1226 fill, a solid 3 px white border and a small white shield line icon, the registration text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents and Spanish punctuation, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: Real phone-photo inset top right (at least 25% of the canvas): woman at a bedroom wardrobe mirror in a burgundy sweater and black jeans flat at the back, hand on the back pocket, worried look over her shoulder
The real closed bottle as a cut-out, tilted about 12 degrees, cropped by the right edge, label readable
Solid dark plum background with the letter on the left and the italic signature
Hot-fuchsia bottom band with 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and a bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand
No needles, syringes, scalpels or medical imagery
No prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials with names or 'envío gratis'; no 'la oferta se acaba'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, benefit lists, ratings, testimonials, discount labels or extra claims beyond the listed band, badge and texts.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. The letter speaks with empathy about a garment fit and a natural routine, with no promised results, no comparison with medical procedures beyond the user's own wish to avoid them, no false urgency and no medical claims.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
